texte.strings:welcomeLeitsatz.text: One place for the data of a whole life
texte.strings:appTagline.text: Everything important in one place: from family and finances to housing, work and health.
texte.strings:welcomeUnterzeile.text: Offline, encrypted, no account. For the doctor's appointment, the move, the emergency: put together what is needed right now.
texte.strings:welcomeWeiter.text: What would you like to do?
texte.strings:welcomeDateiOeffnen.text: Already have a depot? Open file
texte.strings:anlegenFehler.text: The depot could not be created. Please try again.
texte.strings:cryptoPwAufforderung.text: Enter the password for your depot
texte.strings:cryptoInternAufforderung.text: Your depot is on this device.
texte.strings:welcomeInternVorhanden.text: There is already a depot on this device. Starting a new one leaves it untouched: when you unlock, your password opens the depot it belongs to.
texte.strings:wipeSperrschirmHinweis.text: Your depot was closed because {marke} had not been visible for half an hour. Nothing has been lost.
texte.strings:dateiNichtLesbar.text: This file can't be read — it's corrupted or not a depot file.
texte.strings:fehlerFalsch.text: Decryption failed — wrong password or tampered file.
texte.strings:modalOeffnenPwLabel.text: Your six words or your password
texte.strings:ortHinweisAllgemein.text: A note on where the password for this file is kept: {ort}
texte.strings:dateiErkennungAnker.text: This file is your own depot.
texte.strings:dateiErkennungBlackbox.text: This file was given to you by someone else — open it with the password you were given for it.
texte.strings:ablageortKeineFreigabe.text: The file cannot be opened without your permission. You can also choose it via “Open file”.
texte.strings:ablageortNichtErreichbar.text: The file can no longer be found at this location. Please choose it via “Open file”.
texte.strings:dateiFassungUnbekannt.text: This file comes from a different version of the application and can't be opened with this one.
texte.strings:fachAbgelaufen.text: This compartment was valid until {datum} and has expired. The app no longer opens it. Please contact the person who owns the depot.
texte.strings:idbPasswortUndBeschaedigt.text: This password doesn't open any depot on this device. One depot here is damaged, so the password can't be tried on it.
texte.strings:oeffnenKeinStand.text: There's no depot on this device to open. Choose your depot file.
texte.strings:whcOeffnenAufforderung.text: Enter your recovery code and set a new password. The file is then saved with the new password; the code stays valid.
